name: Landhaus Enzian
beschreibung: Landhaus Enzian welcomes guests to a peaceful location on the edge of Walchsee in Tyrol’s scenic Kaiserwinkl region. Framed by green pastures and the limestone walls of the Zahmer Kaiser, the property offers a warm, personal family atmosphere. Well-appointed rooms and holiday apartments feature scenic balconies with panoramic alpine views. A sunbathing lawn in the garden invites peaceful relaxation after active days. Lake Walchsee, renowned for warm swimming waters and watersports, is only moments away. In winter, cross-country ski tracks pass right by the door alongside local ski slopes.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine guesthouse in Walchsee in the Kaiserwinkl region offering mountain views and lake proximity.
